name: USMeS Boot Camp 🥾
description:
Welcome to USMeS Boot Camp🥾
DISCIPLINE + EFFORT = RESULTS.

Welcome to USMeS Boot Camp🥾, your weekly C-paced ride where discipline meets intensity. This isn’t just another group ride—this is where you put in the work.

✅ Average: 2.2–2.8 w/kg
✅ We will average: ~2.5 w/kg overall
✅Fence: In use—and it has no mercy. Stay behind the beacon or risk being zapped.
✅ Duration: 60 Minutes

Ride Format:
• Steady endurance pacing throughout
• Segment efforts are highly encouraged—bring your best watts
• Sprints and climbs will test your focus
• Regroup quickly behind the beacon after each effort

Expectations:
Respect the fence—it’s there to keep everyone disciplined
Use segments to push hard, then fall back in formation
Ride smart, ride steady, and support each other

This is the ride where you earn your progress. Boot Camp🥾 is all about consistency, commitment, and a whole lot of grit.

Fall in, work hard, and finish strong.

BE LIMITLESS

#conqueringlimits #challengeaccepted #embracethesuck
www.usmilitaryesports.com

name: THE SYN 100
description:
Join us for "The SYN 100" group ride on TT bikes! 

This ride is all about teamwork, smooth rotations, and catching up with our community. 
Whether you’re joining to set the pace or sit in and enjoy the draft, what matters most is that you have fun!

We will be taking on 100 km at an average pace of 2.5-3w/kg, ETA +- 2.5 hours. 
Everyone will be on the Canyon Speedmax TT bike — so we’ll be rolling in full style and speed. Double draft is on! 

Perfect for boosting your stamina and endurance, this ride challenges you to hold a steady power output for a sustained duration.

Late join is active for the first 30 minutes of this ride.


3 SPRINTS WITH LEAD-OUT
Tempus Fugit is perfect for time trial efforts, group pacing, and steady endurance work. 
It features the Fuego Flats Sprint — 500 meters of all-out power!
We are riding 5 laps on Tempus Fugit. The first 3 laps we will be organising a sprint with lead-out! 


FINISHING WITH A CHASE
At the end of this ride we have "The spicy 5 ". We’ll lift the pace near the end with 5km to go and go for a fast finish for those who still have energy left. 
Others can just choose to easy spin at a nice pace to the finish line.


UNLOCK THE SYNDICATE CLUB KIT
Completing the full 100km ride today will result in unlocking the inverted SYN Kit that you will be wearing on this ride!
SYN Cycling Club also has other rides that unlock this kit, make sure to check them out!

name: EVO CC Sprint Race Series
description:
CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT IS ENABLED FOR ALL EVO RACES!

What is Category Enforcement? 

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for.  Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You will not be able to race in the D category and the option to join will be absent.

Welcome to EVO sprintrace series. Shorter more compact races for the rider looking for an effective high intensity race. Start fast, hang on in the middle, then sprint for the win at the finish. Expect to push your heart rate to its maximum. Sprinkle a few of these into your training plan and watch your fitness grow.

To make racing as fair as possible we have enforced a few minor rules that will result in automatic disqualification on ZwiftPower.

All riders must wear a heart rate monitor
Riding in an incorrect category.

zPower riders will be disqualified in A, B, and C Podium. zPower is allowed in the D category. Race details and final results will be available at www.zwiftpower.com

#evo

name: Team DRAFT Wednesday Race
description:
WHAT IS CATEGORY ENFORCEMENT?

Category Enforcement will prevent Zwifters from entering a category they are not eligible for. Our goal is to increase fairness in racing.

HOW DOES IT WORK?

- Zwift checks a racer's past performance using VO2 max and FTP to determine their race category.
- Racers can join a category at or above their category. For example, if you are "C" category, you can race in C, B, or A category. You can not race in the D category.

Welcome to the Wednesday Race brought to you by Team DRAFT!

We encourage all participants to head over to zwiftpower.com and register. Riders who have not completed the Zwiftpower registration and agreed to the sharing conditions will not be included in the official results.

To make this race as fair as possible, we require that all riders wear a heart rate monitor, use a power meter and/or smart trainer, and choose the appropriate race category for your ability. Riding in an inappropriate category will lead to your disqualification.

RULES:
- No zPower riders.
- Heart rate monitors mandatory for all categories
- 5min and 20min CEVAZ limits apply. Riding in the wrong category will lead to disqualification.

RACE CATEGORIES:
A: 4.0 W/kg to 5.0 W/kg
B: 3.2 W/kg to 3.99 W/kg
C: 2.5 W/kg to 3.19 W/kg
D: Under 2.49 W/kg

name: Team Italy Workout Series by Manuel Ferrari
description:
Welcome to the Team Italy High-Intensity WORKOUT Series, written by Manuel Ferrari (Manuel Bike Experience) open to all riders with the aim of improving your FTP and preparing for the next races.

The appointment will be for every Tuesday and Thursday evening and is connected with the workouts that we offer every Wednesday evening during the Team Italy Up and Down Intervals event.

Have you always dreamed of completing a ride of over 100 km? Participating in both Team Italy Up and Down Intervals events and today's workout on consecutive days will improve your endurance and transform your ride of over 100 km into a fun ride.

Please add the [ITA] tag after your name,
Your kit will be automatically selected, and all riders will appear with the same kit.
All riders will unlock our exclusive in-game kit at the end of the workout.

How the ERG workout mode works:
The Zwifters line up in the starting area like a normal event and once it starts the workout mode begins. Each one will stay together with the group regardless of the power supplied, calculated on the basis of your FTP current.

We strongly recommend that you perform one of the FTP tests, if this is not correctly estimated it could make the workout too demanding for your current level of preparation, or ineffective. For more information about FTP go to: https://support.zwift.com/hc/en-us/articles/210208083-What-is-FTP-and-how-is-it-used-in-Zwift
This is the Facebook group of Team Italy

Join us! Have fun! Ride On!

name: Wednesday Group Ride Bikes World
description:
Bikes WORLD Group Ride – Every Wednesday
Welcome to the weekly ride organized by the BIKES WORLD club (tag: BIKES), affiliated with BIKES France and primarily intended for non-French speakers, but also open to French speakers who understand English.
Goal: to ride together for about 1 hour on a mostly flat and accessible route with no major difficulties.
📅 When?
Every Wednesday at 5:10 p.m. (UTC + 2), join us for a one-hour group ride on Zwift.
Each week, a different route to mix things up and keep the excitement going!
⚡ Pace: average of 1.5 to 1.8 W/kg (Category D – beginners).
On climbs, the effort may be slightly more intense, but the overall average will remain below 1.8 W/kg.
💬 “Riding alone is great… but riding with friends is even better!”
🎯 Goal: Ride together in a group, in good spirits—this isn’t a race.
Stay close to the leader marked by the yellow marker.
⏱ Gap limit: 10 seconds, to keep the group together. We don’t leave anyone behind.
📌 Sign up now—join us!
➕ Add the tag (BIKES) to your Zwift username and join the BIKES WORLD club on Companion.
💬 Chat with us on Discord: ⁦https://discord.gg/a8wYvgw⁩ (when the leader understands English... lol)
📱 Our Facebook page: ⁦https://www.facebook.com/groups/ZwiftBikes⁩

name: Endurance Beat Pro
description:
Description:
This workout is designed to build your aerobic endurance while maintaining a steady and manageable effort. It consists of a long warm-up, steady state intervals at endurance pace, and a cool-down. Ideal for riders aiming to improve their long-distance capabilities without overreaching.

Structure:
• Warm-Up:
• 10 minutes starting easy and gradually increasing to 55% of FTP.
• Main Set:
• 40 minutes at 70–80% of FTP (Endurance Zone),
• 2:30/3:00 minutes of easy pedaling (55% FTP) between each 40-minute block.
• Cool-Down:
• 10 minutes gradually decreasing effort to % of FTP.

Key Points:
• Focus on maintaining a smooth, efficient pedal stroke.
• Keep your cadence steady between 85–95 rpm.
• Breathing should be controlled; you should be able to hold a conversation during the main intervals.
• Nutrition and hydration are important for sessions lasting over an hour.
Key Elements
Ideal for building aerobic endurance
Keeps attention high thanks to gentle variations
Great for indoor sessions focused on continuous worklink

Baltic Charge Racing League – Your Path to Peak Performance!

The league will consist of 12 stages, with only the best 8 results out of 12 counting towards the overall standings – so consistency, smart race choices, and tactical planning will be key to success!

Step up to the challenge in the Baltic Charge Racing League, where speed, endurance, and strategy come together in a thrilling test of skill.

Inspired by the rich cycling culture of the Baltic States, this series is designed to push riders to new heights with dynamic, fast-paced racing on Zwift’s most iconic routes. More than just a competition, these races are the perfect way to fine-tune your form, sharpen your tactics, and build race-ready fitness ahead of the classical cycling season outdoors.

Expect strategic breakaways, decisive sprints, and non-stop action as riders from around the world push each other to be better with every pedal stroke. Whether you're aiming for the podium or looking to refine your racing instincts, the Baltic Charge Racing League will keep you engaged, motivated, and race-ready.

From the 7th to the 22nd November 2026, IGF riders (and maybe a runner or two) will be taking part in the At Home Winter Wonderwheels mission, powered by Marvel and using Zwift. It’s the UK’s one & only disability sports series for the Everyday Superhero! See: https://superheroseries.co.uk/

This is a social ride, not a race. Use the draft, take a coffee break.

Late joiners allowed.

If you are a member of the WIS community and happy to let the group know, please write [IGF] after your name on your profile.

name: Vision Valkyrie - Recovery Ride
description:
Spin it up! 🥏🌀
This workout helps you improve agility for sprinting. The spinups in high cadence intervals will teach you how to quickly turn your legs, produce power, while keeping the upper body still as a statue and really work on that form. The rotation per minute of your legs (cadence) number will be guided throughout the workout. In between those sets there will be a contrast, low cadence for a couple minutes. 
ERG mode is recommended so you can totally focus on the cadence. 
This workout is found in the recovery folder and is indeed a recovery day workout; from the Jumbo Visma women's team. But! Your heart rate will certainly go up a lot when we are on the high cadence intervals and that is totally normal. Those fast movements to produce high cadence will need some extra heart pumps and get that blood moving.

name: Dragons RT Raceday
description:
Welcome to the weekly Dragons RT Raceday, the midweek race designed for riders who want more than just another group ride.

Every Wednesday, we race a new route in a full-gas scratch race with all categories visible and a single start.

This event is the ideal transfer race between ZRL on Tuesday and TTT on Thursday, and a perfect opportunity for riders who missed ZRL or are not racing TTT but still want a competitive, fair, and meaningful race.

Power-ups available: Feather, Aero, Draft Boost.

To ensure fair racing, a smart trainer, power meter, and heart rate monitor are required.

No zPower riders and no TT bikes.

Final official results are published on ZwiftPower, divided into A, B, C, and D pace groups using Zwift category enforcement.

Riders with unrealistic performances may be excluded until validation is completed.

For the Dragons Racing Team, this race is also a platform to identify new talent. Strong performances, race intelligence, and commitment will be noticed.

Bring your legs.
Bring your head.
Bring your courage.

Work hard. Race fair. Have fun.

And maybe — just maybe — earn your place among the Dragons.

Let’s achieve greatness together.

name: Zwift Racing League Recon Ride (FemmeCycle Collab)
description:
This ZRL Group Recon Ride is led by FemmeCycle Collab (https://www.zwift.com/clubs/260d0d7e-4b91-4162-b025-fd202b8a6e74).

Zwift Racing League Group Recon Rides are the official non-competitive Group Rides. Each one is hosted/run by a participating club and will feature racing tips and tricks for the race ahead, an opportunity to ask questions relating to Zwift Racing League and to preview the full course for Tuesday’s ZRL races.

THE AIM
With experienced ride leaders and Zwifters from a reputable Zwift Club, this is your opportunity to ask questions about all things ZRL-related. You'll be able to learn useful course and team tactics and if you are new to ZRL - perhaps even find a team to race with too!

There are multiple Group Recon Rides to choose from each day at various times and each will operate at the advertised paces (pace is based on your Zwift Pace Group).

WHAT IS THE ZRL?
Introducing the spectacular Zwift Racing League (ZRL) - a turbocharged online bike racing extravaganza that's rewriting the rules of competition. With a staggering 180 community divisions, 1,800 electrifying teams, and a whopping 14,000 fierce racers per 6-week round, the ZRL stands as the undisputed heavyweight champion of online bike racing competitions worldwide.

This high-octane spectacle is masterfully orchestrated by our powerhouse partners, WTRL, who leave no stone unturned in delivering an unparalleled racing experience. But remember, this race is an invitation-only affair, so if you dare to join the ranks of speed demons and thrill-seekers, you'll need to hitch a ride with one of the esteemed existing teams. Fear not, though, for WTRL's website (www.WTRL.racing) is your portal to all the insider intel - schedule, rules, and even a team that perfectly aligns with your fiery spirit!

If you want to gather your own team, you register for the next Round of ZRL at www.wtrl.racing/zwift-racing-league/.

name: TSE POKER CHALLENGE 1/4
description:
TSE Poker Challenge: Virtual Cycling Competition
The TSE Poker Challenge is a virtual cycling competition organized by the TSE club, taking
place every Thursday. The event uses a "tiny" format, consisting of short mini-stages.

Calendar and Structure
The competition includes 4 events, each made up of 4 mini-stages lasting approximately 15

name: PAOLO BARBERA MINEFIELD
description:
Please visit www.heycoach.it or contact me 

Coach Paolo Barbera is a Certified Triathlon and Ironman Coach and the founder of Active Kids, a sporting clinic to help children and adults in the prevention and treatment of obesity through healthy nutrition and tailored training programmes.

Paolo is an experienced triathlete and cyclist. In 2017 he opened an innovative endurance training centre in milan, Tri60, specialized in indoor cycling.

It has been proven that Indoor cycling plays a key role to build strength, resistance and improve overall fitness and technical skills.

Paolo’s workouts are designed to mix different training zones aiming to maximize results in a very short time. Athletes following his workouts, at the right intensity and at the right cadence, have achieved surprising results.

Paolo’s indoor cycling workouts have different lengths to meet every athlete needs.

In the last ten years Paolo has developed very successful training programs for triathletes and cyclists

IT IS NOT HOW YOU START BUT HOW YOU FINISH!

GROUP WORKOUTS

Zwifters line up in the starting area just like a normal event and once the event starts, workout mode begins. Everyone stays together regardless of power output. We highly recommend doing one of the FTP tests to face every workout at the right difficulty level.

name: PUMP: Loop Logic III — Wednesday (3 Laps)
description:
Same Distance. More Laps. Maximum Sass. ♥️🌶️

Welcome to Loop Logic, the weekday series where we prove that "going in circles" is actually a superpower. We’ve curated a week of routes that hit the 19–25km sweet spot with enough climbing to keep your glutes talking back to you.

The Logic is Simple:
We start with one big loop on Monday and add a lap every day until Friday. One lap is a warm-up, but five laps is a statement.

The PUMP Vibe:
Power in Numbers: No band here, ladies! This is your chance to find your rhythm, tuck into a friendly draft, and realize you’re much faster than you think.

Elevation is Our Love Language: Expect at least 100m of climb—just enough to feel the PUMP and earn that post-ride coffee.

Laughter > Watts: We ride hard, but we laugh harder. Whether you’re smashing a PR or just hanging onto a wheel for dear life, do it with a smile.

The Mission:
Show up for yourself, stay for the sisterhood, and let’s show exactly what women-powered logic looks like.

name: Paracycling Group Ride hosted by NCF
description:
Paracyclists from around the world are invited to join this group ride hosted by the Norwegian Cycling Federation.

This event is open to athletes of any ability including those who ride handcycles, tricycles, tandems or standard bicycles.

We will ride for an hour at an easy pace so you can connect with your fellow paracycling friends and competitors.

This ride is configured so that everyone stays together regardless of power output so athletes from all classes can ride with each other.

That's right, if you're outputting 100W and another Zwifter is outputting 400W you will stay in exactly the same position relative to each other. Only if you stop pedalling and fall 6 meters behind the group will the rubber-banding stop. 

You are welcome to join us on discord for a chat. https://discord.gg/vjaxtxc
#ncf

name: ZTBR - Training Stabilization TTT
description:
Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] together with Assessoria Franklin Almeida, provides this training with a focus on providing better "Stabilization" in the performance of athletes seeking better performance in Team Time Trial (TTT) events.

This training aims to help the athlete tolerate and withstand an accumulation of substrates produced by the body in sub-maximal activities, bringing more stability and control in time-based tests.

Franklin Almeida Consulting was created in 2005, with the aim of evaluating the physiological profile, developing training to improve your physical capacity, health and maximum performance.
One of the pioneers in distance consulting in Brazil!

Note: We will have other phases of this training in addition to Stabilization, they are: (Training for FTP Gains and Terrain Variations).

===
Português:
Treino de Estabilização by Franklin Almeida

Descrição: O Zwift Teams Brazil [ZTBR] juntamente com a Assessoria Franklin Almeida, disponibiliza este treino com foco em proporcionar melhor "Estabilização" na performance de atletas que buscam um melhor desempenho nos eventos tipo Team Time Trial (TTT).

Esse treino tem o objetivo de ajudar o atleta a tolerar e suportar um acúmulo de sustratos produzidos pelo organismo em atividades sub máximas trazendo mais estabilidade e controle em provas de conta relógio.

A Consultoria Franklin Almeida foi criada em 2005, com o objetivo de avaliar o perfil fisiológico, desenvolver treinos para melhorar sua capacidade física, sua saúde e desempenho máximo.
Um dos pioneiros em consultoria a distância no Brasil!

Obs.: Teremos outras fases deste treinamento além da Estabilização, são elas: (Treino para Ganhos de FTP e Variações de terreno).

name: Vikings Valhalla Recovery Ride
description:
Welcome to the midweek Recovery Ride hosted by the mighty teams Vikings and Valhalla on Zwift! Join us as we embark on a journey through the virtual landscapes of Zwift, where camaraderie meets relaxation in a friendly and social atmosphere.
As the sun sets on Wednesday evening in Europe, saddle up and pedal alongside fellow riders who share a passion for both fitness and fun. This isn't your typical high-intensity workout—instead, it's a chance to unwind, recover, and rejuvenate those tired legs from previous rides or races.
Our pace is relaxed, our spirits high, and our chat is always filled with laughter and camaraderie. Whether you're a seasoned cyclist or just starting out, everyone is welcome to join in the fun. Share your favorite ride stories, exchange training tips, or simply enjoy the company as we pedal through the virtual roads of Zwift.
So grab your bike, hop on Zwift, and join us for an evening of leisurely pedaling, good vibes, and plenty of laughs. Let's roll together towards recovery, one pedal stroke at a time!
To find out more about our rides, please visit our Valhalla Ride and Race Facebook group https://www.facebook.com/groups/503388660165279/ or our website https://www.skaal.cc

name: ZLDR Starters Run
description:
Beat your first 15k and become a long distance runner

Have you ever wanted to be a long distance runner but intimidated? Don’t know where to start? How to get there? Are you coming back from injury? Have you felt that distance running was too far to run?

No matter how little you’ve run, no matter how “slow” you think you are, no matter what your circumstance. We would like to help you realize your dream of getting to that distant finish line.

ZLDR is a group of diverse runners, from speed demons to walkers, from people just getting to their first 5k to ultra runners. We are here to support your running dreams and help you develop your running skills. We are a collective group of supportive and experienced runners who will make sure that you are never left behind.

15k may seem too far for now but join our Starters Run and stick with us. We will help you build your distance and make it to 15k and beyond. Our starters run is the perfect place to ensure you never run alone. Our team of sweepers will make sure you have the support you need to get to the finish.

👉 Train smart. Train hard. Let’s go!

description:
Turn on the fans and get a towel !, Welcome to SZR Sprint Labs. 
This is a series of short events where you score points only at the first segment of the course on the firt 4 races - the fith is a full Points race with FAL, FTS and Finishing points on three laps on Downtown Dolphin.
We have 5 races to race tonight so make sure you sign up for all of them. 
Race #1: Innsbruckring – Segment: ""Leg Snapper KOM"". Segment start at 5.0 km. Length: 400m, average gradient: 6.9%. You only score points at the segment. And its the fastest time over the segment that wins (FTS).

We do the races as a masstart but you can ride at your own pace up to the segment. Categories are split up after the race. 
We are using powerbased CE categories for this event with the following settings for the categories 
Open Races        zMAP                zFTP
Category A        ≥5.1W/kg        ≥4.2W/kg and ≥250W
Category B        ≥4.1W/kg        ≥3.36W/kg and ≥200W
Category C        ≥3.2W/kg        ≥2.625W/kg and ≥150W
Category D        <3.2W/kg        <2.625W/kg or <150W
Category E        <2.625w/kg or <150w

Race rules
- HRM is mandatory
- Ride what bike you like
- Power Source is Mandatory for all racers. A smart trainer or smart bike should be your power source where possible. ZPower is not allowed.

Scoring FTS Points from 50-2 points at the segment, riders after position 50 will recive 1 point on the segment. 

Results and GC is presented after the race at https://www.zwiftpower.com

description:
Welcome to our VirtuSlo Wacky Wednesday Race. 
The Rules are simple: finish as fast as possible and have Fun!


PEN -> Zwift Racing Score
Pen A / 666 - 800
Pen B / 555 - 666
Pen C / 444 - 555
Pen D / 333 - 444
Pen E / 0 - 333
- You may increase your Zwift Racing Score up to 30-points over the PEN Range as a result of the race and your race will stand. If you breach PEN Range Limits by >30-points, then it is likely you didn’t have a maximal 5-minute effort in your 90-day history and you will be upgraded to the correct PEN.

RULES AND RACE Settings
- No Powerups
- No TT Bikes
- Participants must be registered on zwiftpower.com to be included in the results
- Smart trainer or Power Meter required.
- Heart Rate Monitor required.
- No Indoor Bikes without Controlled Resistance (Cadence=Power)
- Sticky Watts or unusual pedalling technique to get an unrealistic advantage will result in DQ

MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS
- Zwift Activities must be saved PUBLIC for verification.
- Elite Level Performances above the limits stated below must be supported by DUAL POWER Recordings uploaded to Zwiftpower and with margin off error of less than 4%. Outside KOM efforts on Strava can be used for verification of Dual Power analysis.
*MEN: above 4.8W/kg or 350W for 20min, 5.5W/kg or 425W for 5min, 9W/kg for 1min.
**WOMEN: above 4.5W/kg or 280W for 20min, 5W/kg or 325w for 5min, 7.5W/kg for 1min.

name: TSE POKER CHALLENGE 3/4
description:
TSE Poker Challenge: Virtual Cycling Competition
The TSE Poker Challenge is a virtual cycling competition organized by the TSE club, taking
place every Thursday. The event uses a "tiny" format, consisting of short mini-stages.

Calendar and Structure
The competition includes 4 events, each made up of 4 mini-stages lasting approximately 15
minutes each.

Race Times (Italian Time): 19:05, 19:25, 19:45, and 20:05.

Regulations and Technical Requirements
The event is open to categories A, B, C, and D with Category Enforcement active.
● Equipment: You may choose your preferred bike, but Time Trial (TT) bikes are
prohibited.
● Mandatory: A heart rate monitor is required; zPower is not allowed.
● Settings: Drafting and steering are enabled, while Powerups are disabled.
● Scoring: A dynamic system is used based on the number of participants (e.g., 60 starters
= 60 points for 1st place, 1 point for the last).
● Penalties: Athletes who change categories during the tour will receive penalties.

For technical support or team registrations, contact the organizers at

name: Inox Master Phenotypes Cup 💨 Sprint 1/3
description:
3 short races, flat-climb-TT, to discover your racing phenotype, with categories based on age (Cat. A=up to 29 years, B=30–39, C=40–49, D=50–59, E=60+):
are you more of a sprinter, a climber, or a time trialist?

The races take place 20 minutes apart, making this format ideal for high-intensity efforts with recovery in between, perfect both for racing and structured training.

Each race focuses on a different specialty:

Race 1 – Sprint: a flat course, ideal for pure sprinters
Race 2 – Climb: a hilly route, designed for climbers

name: Cycling Weekly Club 10
description:
The evening ten is a staple of the British club scene as riders up and down the country will compete with their club mates midweek on a local course. Typically run following the post rush hour traffic the evening ten is as social as it is competitive as road riders, time trailer and club-men come together to compete, chase kudos and bragging rights.
 
About this race
Join staff members of Cycling Weekly, multiple time trial national champion Dr Hutch and a few special guests for a classic, ten mile time trial effort. Using a variety of courses on the Zwift platform the CW club ten will be a test of your power and your pacing. Results will feature on Zwift Power and in Cycling Weekly magazine each week alongside a profile of a competitor.
 
How to ride a TT
As the courses vary, so will your pacing. The flattest courses require a steady sustained effort. With the effort lasting anywhere between 20 and 30 minutes depending on your speed, you will need to know what power you can sustain for that amount of time, getting you across the line with little left in your legs. Finish too fresh and you haven’t pushed hard enough, but if you start slowing before you cross the line, you’ve gone out too hard.
 
When on the hillier courses pacing strategy becomes even more important. Time can be gained on rivals by pushing on the ascents and recovering on the descents, just don’t back off too much. But remember, if there’s a harder climb near the end, you’ll need to hold a little back to maintain your power output in the final push.
 
Your aim should be to ‘get it all out’. If you do this you’ll know you couldn’t have gone any faster. Come back each week and you’ll see an improvement, and be ranked in the series on Zwift Power.
 
How to join the event
Join via the Zwift companion app and be pedalling in a Zwift world well ahead of the event start time. You’ll be given a prompt to join the event in the bottom left of the screen. Do this and you’ll be taken to the start and placed on a conveyor belt where you can keep spinning your legs until you get to the front of the queue. When the time comes your avatar will speed up to 20 miles per hour for a rolling start.
 
About Dr Michael Hutchinson
Ten time winner of the national ten, six time winner of the national 25 and thirteen time winner of the national 50. Dr Hutch is also a best selling author having written about his attempt at the Hour Record and his thirst for going ever faster. He works as an aerodynamic consultant to Team Ireland and writes a weekly column in Cycling Weekly magazine
 
About Cycling Weekly
Established in 1891 Cycling Weekly is the oldest cycling magazine in the world and the only weekly publication. Covering international and domestic racing, the magazine also covers health, fitness and nutrition and reviews of the latest tech.

The TSE Poker Challenge is a virtual cycling competition organized by the TSE club, taking
place every Thursday. The event uses a "tiny" format, consisting of short mini-stages.

Calendar and Structure
The competition includes 4 events, each made up of 4 mini-stages lasting approximately 15
minutes each.

Regulations and Technical Requirements
The event is open to categories A, B, C, and D with Category Enforcement active.
● Equipment: You may choose your preferred bike, but Time Trial (TT) bikes are
prohibited.
● Mandatory: A heart rate monitor is required; zPower is not allowed.
● Settings: Drafting and steering are enabled, while Powerups are disabled.
● Scoring: A dynamic system is used based on the number of participants (e.g., 60 starters
= 60 points for 1st place, 1 point for the last).
● Penalties: Athletes who change categories during the tour will receive penalties.

name: ZZRC Thunder Charge
description:
ZZRC Thunder Charge | 2.8–3.2 W/kg

Welcome to ZZRC Thunder Charge! This is a group ride, not a race. We encourage everyone to ride together, enjoy the pace and have a chat along the way.

ZZRC was founded in 2015 and is one of Zwift’s longest established clubs. Our rides welcome all riders. Category enforcement helps us provide a safe, consistent experience for the group.

Pace and group riding

The Yellow Beacon will pace the ride at an average of 2.8–3.2 W/kg. The effort may rise briefly on climbs or during sprints, but the overall average will remain within the advertised range.

We use the Fence on most rides to help keep the group together and prevent the pace from creeping up. This ride also uses Double Draft.

If you fall behind the main group, catching back on will require an effort above the group’s pace. There are no sweeps on this ride. If you cannot rejoin, settle into a comfortable pace with riders around you. We will still be in touch through the on-screen messages.

Bike choice and late join

TT bikes are not permitted. They do not draft, so you would need to work harder to stay with the group. Mountain bikes offer very little draft and will also require extra effort, especially when chasing back on.

A 30-minute late join window is available if you have a technical issue or lose the group early in the ride. Rejoining during that window should teleport you back to the main group with the Yellow Beacon.

Top tips

1. Stay close to the ride leader. On climbs, riding just ahead can help you avoid a gap opening and the elastic snapping.
2. Give the Fence some space—we don’t want anyone getting fried!
3. Most importantly, have fun and enjoy the ride.

We love a chat, so join us on Discord⁠￼. You can also find ZZRC – We Pace Not Race on Facebook and join our club in the Zwift Companion app.

#ZZRC

name: Mountain Massif structured training:  Foothills Openers
description:
Created by Mountain Massif in collaboration with Vekta, this structured training session is part of an 8-week plan designed to get you fit and back to your best. The plan was built using AI and years of real training data held in Vekta, learning from what has worked before to create a progressive programme of three sessions a week, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday. This is week 1, Wednesday.  About the session: Short, punchy 30/30s to open up the legs. A gentle introduction to high-intensity work - perfect for the foothills of the plan.
Session details:
Warm Up 
12 min 45%–75% FTP

Steady endurance before set one 
3 min 65% FTP, free cadence

Set 1 
6 x 30 s @ 120% FTP / 30 s @ 50% FTP, 100 rpm

Recovery 
4 min 50% FTP, free cadence

Set 2 
6 x 30 s @ 120% FTP / 30 s @ 50% FTP, 100 rpm

Recovery 
4 min 50% FTP, free cadence

Final set 
6 x 30 s @ 120% FTP / 30 s @ 50% FTP, 100 rpm

Ten minutes of steady endurance to finish the work 
10 min 65% FTP, free cadence

Cool Down 
7 min 40%–55% FTP

Total Time: 58 minutes

Key coaching cues:
Keep your cadence high (around 100 rpm) on the hard 30 seconds; it makes the efforts feel lighter. Ride in ERG mode: every target is a percentage of your FTP, so the session suits all levels.

Safety Note:  Only undertake vigorous exercise if you are fit and healthy to do so. If you are at all unsure, consult a Physician or Doctor first. All training equipment including Bikes and Turbo trainers should be in full working order. Do not use any piece of equipment that does not come up to the required standard.
More information: For more information check out the Mountain Massif website www.mountainmassif.com, follow on Instagram @mountain_massif, Facebook @mountainmassif and join our Zwift Club, by clicking the following link https://www.zwift.com/clubs/mountainmassif/home
To record all your training data and chart your progress, consider using Vekta by following the link https://joinvekta.com/

on Torturefest Cult discord ITT Climbing room.

dilemma; TT bike, climbing bike or mid race bike change?
• What is the intensity of your effort on each climb in a week where the course has
multiple climbs?
• How do you regulate your power on the flat sections before or between climbs?
One week its long drag climbs, next week its multiple smaller climbs…weekly climbing
Russian roulette style.

name: ZZRC Happy Hour
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Happy Hour 2.4-2.8wkg. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and is one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift.

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 2.4 - 2.8 on the ride, with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints, but the average for the whole ride will be as advertised.

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over-paced.

In the event of falling off the back of the main group, you will need to pace well over the group pace to bridge the gap and catch.

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to the group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process.

Our crew is a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift.

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps, and Ride Buddies.

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances, our Sweeps will not be able to help you.

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, with minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to the group.

All our rides have a 30-minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON.

Double Draft is used on this ride

We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel
https://discord.gg/QdeS3PtXTX

TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app.

Try it - YOU MIGHT JUST LIKE IT!
Our ZHCC Rubber Band Club has the “rubber-band” activated which means that no matter what level you are, you will be able to keep up and the group WILL STAY TOGETHER. The rubber band allows you to ride at your own pace, slow or fast and you are guaranteed to stay in the group.
The ride speed will be slightly less than you would normally experience in a group ride due to the rubber band effect, but we feel that's a small price to pay to allow all level of riders to remain together throughout the ride.
In this supportive environment it’s a great way of completing a full 1 hour ride knowing you wont get dropped or get dragged along by those naughty fliers!
ZHCC do not race each other, we ride as one, have fun and enjoy a group ride.
The ZHCC gang look forward to riding with you.

name: Stonegrinder Series
description:
Welcome to the Stonegrinder Series, 8 weeks of racing across selected Brick and Cobble sectors from around Zwift.

Each week features one designated Sprint or KOM segment. Some rounds will be short and explosive, others much longer, but only one thing matters: your fastest time through the selected segment.

Drafting is disabled, power ups are off and TT bikes are not allowed. Bike and wheel choice is otherwise completely open.

Most events use a custom finish shortly after the selected segment. The event finish itself does not count towards the series. It is only there to make sure the full segment is completed and recorded.

There are 4 global time slots each week. You can race more than one slot, with your fastest valid segment time of the round counting towards the league.

The standings are based first on how many rounds you complete, then on your cumulative segment time. So 8 completed rounds will always rank ahead of 7, 7 ahead of 6, and so on.

Season 1 runs every Wednesday from 4th November to 23rd December.

Live standings and league positions will be available on ZwiftPower.

name: FRR PowerLeague S1 - FINISHER Race
description:
Flamme Rouge Racing are excited to bring you the Power League, where you decide what you are and just go race for your Club.

Three race formats to choose from Sprinter, Climber and Finisher - if you like to power through a race in an iTT then choose the Finisher race, otherwise the other 2 options are self explanatory.

Scoring
Sprint races award points for SPRINT segments ONLY by fastest time by Pen across all race times and finish points from your race - if there is a climb there are no points for them.
Climb races award points for CLIMB segments ONLY by fastest time by Pen across all race times and finish points from your race - if there is a sprints there are no points for them.
iTT races it's all about time to finish by pen across all race times

Best 2 scoring riders from each race and class count for the Clubs Team score

Results are by gender but for this first series we will keep everyone together using ZRS to separate the Pens

Leaderboards by Club, Race format all by each racing class

For all details and registration vist our website:
https://flammerougeracing.com/

Primary Communication via DISCORD

Discord - PowerLeague channel for questions, updates and lively chat - it is by far the best place to clarify or report anything during the series

Invite link: https://discord.com/invite/nQNWHQK6PS

Smart Trainers & Power Meters
- Smart Trainers must be used as a riders PRIMARY POWER SOURCE
- POWER METERS can be used as Primary source if a Smart Trainer is not available for all other divisiions
- Riders must understand that if verification is required that Race Control can verify with the Zwift platform if a rider has used a power meter as a primary power source over a smart trainer. 

Why is this important - Video's may show that a riders BIO is fine and their setup looks good but this doesn't confirm that's what they used - we can now verify the trainer connected where required because it is known that PMs data can be altered and settings tweaked to produce more power.

So be SMART and use a SMART trainer as your PRIMARY power source where you can....

FRR Code of Conduct
- We expect the best racing behavior from all riders, if riders have an issue then always contact race control via email first, we will investigate every request raised.
- In race we do not expect riders to abuse others, flag, report to race control, screen shot etc.... riders who ignore this will be DQ'd for the season
- Discord chat remains objective and banter - anything more will be removed and warnings/bans will be issued

And finally remember we all do this for fun and exercise so ride on and enjoy the FRR events....stay safe and if it starts to hurt then welcome to the fun zone...! 
(But stop if it really does hurt too much please!)

name: Micro Mountain Massif Race 3 - Powered by Muc-Off
description:
This event is built for one thing: unleashing everything you’ve got on a short, explosive climb. It’s your chance to go full gas, push beyond your perceived limits, and battle shoulder to shoulder with fellow racers all the way to the summit.

Victory won’t come from strength alone—it will come from smart racing. Do you conserve energy across the flat approach before launching your attack on the climb? Or do you go all-in from the gun, daring the field to hold your wheel? Every decision shapes the outcome, and only you can decide when to make your move.

Not chasing the win? This race is the perfect opportunity to test your five-minute power. Hold your highest sustainable effort to the finish, improve your ZwiftPower rankings, and see exactly what you’re capable of. Whether you’re racing for glory or racing the clock, this unique event delivers a challenge worth remembering.

name: ZZRC Static Spinners Sub 2
description:
Welcome to our ZZRC Static Spinners Sub 2. This is a group ride, not a race, where we encourage riding together.

Our rides are open to all riders, the category enforcement merely allows us to ensure a safe and quality ride for you the riders and for our group.

In 2015 ZZRC was founded and are one of the oldest established clubs on Zwift .

YELLOW BEACON will pace between 1.7-1.9 on the ride , with a possible increase of watts on inclines or sprints , but the average for the whole ride will be sub 2 .

We strongly promote group riding so on most of our rides we will use the Fence to help encourage that. Using a fence ensures that the ride is not over paced .

In the event of falling off the back of the main group , you will need to pace well over group pace to bridge the gap and catch .

This is where our awesome ZZRC sweeps and Ride Buddies will help you return to group using their draft. They will give you clear encouraging instructions to aid this process .

Our crew are a caring bunch who dedicated a lot of hours to this club , but want you to have the best ride experience on Zwift

You will be fully supported and encouraged throughout the ride by the Leader, Sweeps and Ride Buddies .

Our rides do not allow the use of TT Bikes as they do not draft and will require you to push harder on the ride, and in these instances our Sweeps will not be able to help you .

Mountain bikes operate very similarly, minimum draft so more watts (effort) will be required for the ride and any chase backs to group .

All our rides have a 30 minute late join feature which allows you to rejoin if you have technical issues or you find yourself out of the group in the early stages of the ride. Using this feature SHOULD teleport you back into the main group with our YELLOW BEACON .


We love to have a chat on our rides so join us on our dedicated discord channel for our sub 2
https://discord.gg/RJ3dhbjCEp


TOP TIPS

1) Stay close to the ride leader (or just in front on climbs), don’t let a gap form and the elastic snap!

2) Stay away from the Fence – We don’t like to fry anyone

3) Most important of all . . . HAVE FUN AND ENJOY THE RIDE.

#zzrc

Don’t forget to join our ZZRC-We Pace Not Race Facebook page and our club on the companion app

name: Good Time Riders - Pursuit Race
description:
Also known as Chase races, or Cat and Mouse races, the D category riders will start first, followed by a staggered start for C, B and finally A riders. Keep an eye on the map to see where the other riders are. Who will make it to the finish first? 

You’ll need to work in groups to try and reach the final few kilometres of the race somewhere near the front,  and then it’s all out effort for the overall win. 
 
Good Time Riders (GTR) are a group of Zwifters from across the world who enjoy
riding, training and racing together. We race hard, encourage one another
to be their best, but enjoyment comes first. We have active teams at all
levels racing in Club Ladder, TTT, ZRL and DIRT series. We also run a
regular group rides for the Zwift community on Mondays and Fridays. New members are always very welcome, you can find us on the Companion App, Zwift Clubs, Facebook and Discord.

name: ☕ CAPPUCCINO & EXPRESSO 💥 served by KLUB
description:
🍕 KLUB.CC // KILOMETERS. LACTATE. UNITY. BREAKAWAYS.
☕ CAPPUCCINO & EXPRESSO 💥 served by KLUB

⬇️ ENGLISH RIDE DETAILS BELOW
🗓️ Jeden Mittwoch · 19:45 Uhr ⏱️ + 30 Minuten Late Join

💥 EXPRESSO mit X. Denn wenn aus Espresso Eskalation wird, gibt es den legendären EXPRESSO. #eseskalierteh

👕 UNLOCK & WIN 🎰 Das Zwift KLUB Kit gibt es nach jedem Ride als Unlock in die Zwift Garage und ein unique KLUB Shirt wird in jedem Ride verlost.

☕ CAPPUCCINO PACE · 2,0-2,5 W/kg

Wir rollen wie bei jeder guten Ausfahrt draußen gemeinsam durch die offene Zwift-Welt: Gruppe halten, Windschatten nutzen, quatschen, Kilometer sammeln.

Der Ride ist ein No-Drop-Event um die angekündigte Pace: Wenn ihr den Anschluss verliert und Hilfe braucht, meldet euch bitte früh und deutlich im Companion-Chat. Nicht erst, wenn die Gruppe schon am Horizont verschwindet - je früher ihr ruft, desto einfacher bekommen wir euch wieder zurück.

💥 EXPRESSO ESKALATION

Gemeinsam rollen heißt nicht, dass es die ganze Zeit entspannt bleibt. Ausgewählte Segmente und die letzten Kilometer Richtung Ziel sind unsere virtuellen Ortsschildsprints. Wer EXPRESSO mag, darf hier kurz den entspannten Modus verlassen und ordentlich Laktat in die Beine pumpen.

📢 Gewertet werden ausschließlich die Segmente, die während des Rides angesagt und freigegeben werden.

Danach gilt:

REGROUP. CAPPUCCINO MODE ON. ☕

🏁 Auch die letzten Kilometer Richtung Ziel starten erst auf das GO vom Lead.

🥇🥈🥉 COFFEE CUP

⚡ FTS · Fastest Through Segment
Auf jedem gewerteten Sprint gibt es Punkte entsprechend der Anzahl der Teilnehmenden. Platz für Platz geht es jeweils einen Punkt nach unten, bis noch 1 Punkt übrig bleibt.

⛰️ KOM = DOUBLE SHOT
Gewertete KOMs bringen die doppelte Punktzahl.

🏁 RACE FINAL · FAL
Auf den freigegebenen letzten Kilometern zählt die Reihenfolge im Ziel. Dabei wird noch einmal die Summe der maximal verfügbaren Segmentpunkte des jeweiligen Rides verteilt.

🪩 COOLDOWN AFTERPARTY · +30 MIN

Nach dem Ziel ist noch nicht Schluss. Wir rollen noch 30 Minuten locker weiter: Beine ausschütteln, Laktat entsorgen, quatschen und den Ride gemeinsam ausrollen.

🏆 Für jeden Ride gibt es 10 Punkte für die Saisonwertung von September bis März. Die besten 5 jeder Kategorie bekommen noch einmal 5 bis 1 Punkt on top.

🚴🏽‍♀️🚴🏼‍♂️🚴🏾 EVERYONE IS WELCOME

Alle Teams, Freundinnen, Freunde und alle, die Lust auf gemeinsames Rollen und ein paar gepflegte Eskalationen haben, sind herzlich eingeladen. Erzählt es weiter und kommt vorbei!

Neben der Einzelwertung gibt es eine Teamwertung. Dafür zählen pro Woche und Kategorie jeweils die drei besten Ergebnisse eines Teams.

☕ CAPPUCCINO für alle.
💥 EXPRESSO für alle, die ballern wollen.

--------------

🍕 KLUB.CC // KILOMETERS. LACTATE. UNITY. BREAKAWAYS.
🌎 ENGLISH RIDE DETAILS

☕ CAPPUCCINO & EXPRESSO 💥 served by KLUB
🗓️ Every Wednesday · 7:45 PM CET/CEST ⏱️ + 30 minutes Late Join

💥 Yes, EXPRESSO with an X. Because when espresso turns into escalation, it becomes the legendary EXPRESSO. #eseskalierteh

👕 UNLOCK & WIN 🎰 The Zwift KLUB Kit is unlocked for your Zwift Garage after every ride, and a cool KLUB shirt is raffled off during our ride.

☕ CAPPUCCINO PACE · 2.0-2.5 W/kg

We roll together through the open Zwift world just like on a good ride outside: stay with the group, enjoy the draft, chat and collect kilometres.

This is a no-drop event around the announced pace: If you lose contact and need help, call out early and clearly in the Companion Chat. Don’t wait until the bunch has disappeared over the horizon - the sooner you shout, the easier it is for us to bring you back.

💥 EXPRESSO ESCALATION

Riding together doesn’t mean taking it easy all the way. Selected segments and the final kilometres towards the finish are our virtual town-sign sprints. If EXPRESSO is your thing, this is where you can leave chill mode behind for a moment and pump some serious lactate into the legs.

📢 Only segments announced and released during the ride count towards the competition.

Afterwards:

REGROUP. CAPPUCCINO MODE ON. ☕

🏁 The final kilometres towards the finish also start only on the Lead’s GO.

🥇🥈🥉 COFFEE CUP

⚡ FTS · Fastest Through Segment
Each counted sprint awards points based on the number of participants. Each position receives one point less until 1 point remains.

⛰️ KOM = DOUBLE SHOT
Counted KOMs award double points.

🏁 RACE FINAL · FAL
Once the final kilometres are released, finishing position counts. The total number of maximum segment points available during that ride is distributed once again at the finish.

🪩 COOLDOWN AFTERPARTY · +30 MIN

Cross the finish line and stick around. We keep rolling easy for another 30 minutes: spin out the legs, dump the lactate, chat and finish the ride together.

🏆 Every ride earns you 10 points towards the season standings from September to March. The top 5 in each category score another 5 to 1 bonus points on top.

🚴🏽‍♀️🚴🏼‍♂️🚴🏾 EVERYONE IS WELCOME

All teams, friends and everyone who enjoys rolling together with a few well-timed escalations are more than welcome. Spread the word and come ride with us!

Alongside the individual standings, there is also a team classification. The three best results per team, category and week count towards it.

☕ CAPPUCCINO for everyone.
💥 EXPRESSO for everyone who wants to send it.

ℹ️ LANGUAGE INFO

Lead communication during each ride is primarily in German, but of course all Zwifters are welcome! Segment calls are clear and easy to follow. If you need any information in English, just let us know in the chat at any time - we’ll be happy to help.

name: FAAST CREW SOCIAL RIDE!
description:
COME JOIN THE CREW! https://taplink.cc/faastcrew
.
FAAST CREW GROUP RIDES! 🤘
Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday Zwift rides! Everyone is welcome to join… let’s have some fun and get them GAINZ!
.
TUESDAY FTP BUILDER! @ 18:45(gmt)
It’s time to put the work in… each week we will be aiming to push your limits with a workout aimed to boost those FTP numbers…
Come get involved and watch yourself get stronger each week.
.
WEDNESDAY SOCIAL RIDE! @ 18:45(gmt)
Social pace night (banded together)
The main aim of these rides will be to keep things easy and sociable… not only to allow for a wider range of capabilities to get involved… but if you’re looking to get stuck in on Thursdays ride, have yourself an active rest day and use this ride to get to know your riding buddies.
There will also be some “optional” watt bombs being dropped… get involved if you fancy some sprint training!
.
THURSDAY CHAIN GANG! @ 18:45(gmt)
Chain gang night (around 4w/kg)
Come get stuck in and let’s empty those tanks!
This will be a full gas effort… we work as a unit for the most part, let’s try keep things together and help keep the pack strong… and we will operate a sweeper up until the half way mark.
There will however be a sprint finish with results, so the last 5-10minutes it’s every man/woman for themselves. Get stuck in and try take the glory.
This will be a race format but the finish line is an imaginary one as the clock hits zero.
.
LATE JOIN is enabled, so you can join us up to 30 mins after the start time, with the event link.
.
Please help spread the word, invite your pals and be sure to tag us in anything you post… we like to see you suffering, so post on your story of you smashing those pedals and tag @faastcrew.
.
PLEASE JOIN OUR ZWIFT CLUB.
That’s where all the rides will be posted but if you happen to miss them make sure to follow our Instagram page and keep up to date with any upcoming events and announcements.
(All relevant links, click the tap link in bio)
.
We look forward to seeing you all there, come get involved and LET’S HAVE IT!
.
The FAAST CREW.

name: TBR MounTRONeering
description:
TBR Mountroneering is your opportunity to climb Watopia’s biggest mountain, Alpe du Zwift, in a regular weekly group ride.

Our awesome team are here to help you reach new heights!

Key points
• Have fun, enjoy the ride and making new friends while suffering a little together
• Roll out at 2.5w/kg for 5km to the base of the climb
• Climb the 12.2km with 1036m of elevation at 2.9w/kg (sub 70 minute ascent)
• An optional Smasho race is often added from turn 4 to the finish line for those with fresh legs
• After the climb the Yellow beacon group will ‘drop like a rock’, your chance to break a PR and potentially hit 100km/hr
• This is a no fence ride, you won’t get heckled for riding at your own pace (whether faster or slower)

name: Team CLS - Pace 'n' Race: Midweek Recon and Activation
description:
Ride ‘n’ Explore becomes a mid-week edition of our popular Pace ‘n’ Race format. This is an ideal mid week steady spin, giving the opportunity to recon a route and have a mini blast at the end of the ride. 

This is a chance to enjoy a friendly experienced midweek group ride with regulars who have no Big Egos. This is also ideal for racers participating in ZRL or DRS as this will often be a great recon opportunity on an upcoming route. Outside of these series, you will always have an enjoyable blast on a favorite route.

The ride will hold a steady pace to get the legs going and towards the end we will aim to form a PACE group that will remain steady, and a RACE group that will have the opportunity to get in a mini effort/race as a short blast to the finish!


Information and Rules
• Please follow the beacon's calls to ensure the group remains smooth and everyone gets the most out of the event.
• The Fence will be used and it is 'live' so if you go ahead of the group for too long, you will be removed from the event. 


WEEKLY PROGRAM

name: RollCo: Rolling Tide - 41K
description:
🌊 ROLLING TIDE
Start small. Build big.
Welcome to Rolling Tide — RollCo’s season-long ritual race.

Every week, the distance grows by 1 km.
It begins as a short, explosive opener and steadily evolves into a full-distance endurance epic by year’s end.
This isn’t a one-off event — it’s a shared journey that rises with you.

🏁 Race Format
Rolling Tide is a categorised scratch race.
All riders start together, with categories keeping the racing fair and fast.
The only thing that changes… is the distance.

Week 1 → 1 km
Week 52 → 52 km

Early weeks reward raw power.
Later weeks demand patience, grit, and endurance.
The tide never stops rising.

Rolling Tide is about more than today’s finish line.
It’s about showing up — week after week.
Seeing the same names.
Measuring how far you’ve come as the distance stretches.

You’ll build rivalries.
You’ll track your progress.
You’ll remember the day it all began.

And by the end of the season, everyone who stayed will share the same truth:

“We rode the whole tide together.”

Why Join Rolling Collective?
We’re more than a club — we’re a global community of riders who support each other, grow together, and celebrate every ride, whether it’s a grind, a badge hunt, or a race. Join us on Discord, connect with fellow riders, and be part of something bigger.

Forward, Together

description:
Welcome to the Van Rysel exit it will be a friendly outing in

group leader with whom you can interact and who will help you acquire

name: Pedal Mafia | Hour of Power
description: Join Pedal Mafia for our signature 60 minute ride! This is your chance to spin legs and share wheels with the brand founders and the rest of the global team. Whether you are looking to test your fitness or just want to roll with a great crew, this ride is for you. Push your limits, chat with the creators, and experience the community vibe first-hand. The Best Part? Crossing the finish line unlocks the exclusive Pedal Mafia Core Kit for your in-game avatar. See you on the start line!

name: Cheesecake Crew - Chase the Cake
description:
Looking for something to help tackle the mid-week blues? Why not come and join the Cheesecake Crew for a fun-filled ride with a little bit of something for everyone.
We’ll cruise round together at a steady 2.7-3.0wkg before the start of our optional race ending – the Cake Chase!
Don’t want to race this week, we’ve got you covered. Our Yellow beacon will continue to cruise on home at the advertised pace.
Race or pace? The choice is yours. Whatever you choose you’ll be guaranteed a warm welcome and good old chin wag.

name: ZSUN Wendurance
description:
Join our weekly ZSUN-Wendurance Ride – a relaxed yet endurance-focused group
ride!
This is not a race, but a social endurance ride where teamwork, steady pacing,
and group spirit come first. We’ll keep the pace consistent between 2.3 – 2.5
W/kg so everyone can stay together and enjoy a smooth ride.
What to expect:

Steady pace between 2.3–2.5 W/kg* Focus on endurance, group discipline, and
fun* Ride leader will guide the pace and keep the group together* Occasional
climbs could exceed the above mentioned pace, but stay below 3.0W/kg* Great
chance to train, chat, and ride with the ZSUN community
Whether you’re building your endurance base, looking for a solid group workout,
or just want to enjoy the ride with friendly company —> ZSUN Wendurance is the
place to be!
💡 Tip: Stay close to the leader, make use of the draft, and enjoy the group
energy – together we go further!For enhanced experience join in the banter and
talk to us live on discord: https://discord.gg/rUVuu6pd

eventSubgroups.name: ZSUN Wendurance (C)
eventSubgroups.description:
ZSUN Wendurance is a social weekly event where we concentrate on the steady pacing, team work, staying together as a group and improving endurance, while encouraging and supporting each other.

Average pace will be kept at 2.3 - 2.5 w/kg, with occasional climbs staying at under 3.0 w/kg.

Ride leader will set the tempo and help maintain group cohesion.

This is an ideal session to build endurance, get a solid workout, while enjoying a friendly and supportive banter.

Riders are encouraged to stay close to the leader, maximize draft and enjoy competitive energy.

name: Zwift Racing: Racing 101
description:
Ready to cross the start line but not sure what to expect? Zwift Racing: Racing 101 helps you build the skills and confidence to take on your first race.

Designed for beginners and curious riders, this guided ride breaks down the fundamentals in a friendly, low-pressure environment. Learn what to expect at the start, how to make the most of the draft, use PowerUps and manage your effort. You’ll also discover four different ways to race, so you can start finding your place in racing.

name: CTT Winter Series on Zwift
description:
Join us for the CTT Winter Series on Zwift. 

Complete 7 events (3 x Flat Courses, 3 x Rolling courses and 1 x Mountain course) to qualify for the series championship. 

Categories are determined by your vELO Rating so enter any pen but try to enter the one most suited to your ability. Find your vELO rating here: https://www.zwiftracing.app. 

You can find out more at our Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61581972670459&locale=en_GB or on our Discord server: https://discord.gg/2xsFDQkAuE 

We look forward to racing with you!

name: SNOW CC Points Race League
description:
SNOW CC runs this weekly Zwift Points Race League. Each race offers 175 points for each race, 100 points for the finish, and 75 points for the primes. The series is 10 races and your best 5 count. Do them all, or pick your favorite course. All points are First Across the Line, including the finish. We publish the results and the league on Zwift Power, and we announce each race course and the points scoring on our Facebook Page on a Thursday.

Please see our Facebook page for more information about weekly races and special events:

https://www.facebook.com/SNOWCCRacingLeague

Race results are published on Zwift Power. You must be a member of ZwiftPower to score points.
See https://zwiftpower.com/ for details.

SNOW CC is a Zwift Race Team dedicated to fair and transparent racing on Zwift. We run a number of events on Zwift and welcome new members who are committed to maintaining the highest standards in Zwift Racing
